message.content: {"note_claim": "The image is edited from an original photo of an arrest where the shirt was plain gray, with a 'Latinos for Trump' slogan added digitally, so it is not an authentic ICE photo.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "An image showing a man in a \"Latinos for Trump\" shirt being taken away by ICE officers is fake – the real photo from five years ago has been altered.", "reason": "The page says the image is a doctored version of a real photo showing a man in a plain gray shirt, which substantiates the note's core claim, though it places the original in Ohio in 2018 (by ICE/Getty) rather than Georgia in 2020 (AP), and its altered slogan says 2024 rather than 2027."}

parsed.note_claim: The image is edited from an original photo of an arrest where the shirt was plain gray, with a 'Latinos for Trump' slogan added digitally, so it is not an authentic ICE photo.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: An image showing a man in a "Latinos for Trump" shirt being taken away by ICE officers is fake – the real photo from five years ago has been altered.
parsed.reason: The page says the image is a doctored version of a real photo showing a man in a plain gray shirt, which substantiates the note's core claim, though it places the original in Ohio in 2018 (by ICE/Getty) rather than Georgia in 2020 (AP), and its altered slogan says 2024 rather than 2027.
